name: Donald Trump
description: Follow Donald Trump, a tracked person, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Trump looms as tensions flare in final Maine Senate debate
changes.summary: The marathon of debates in the Maine Senate race has ended, but there is still one unanswered question: Just how large will President Donald Trump loom in November?

changes.title: Trump Ally, Paolo Zampolli, Leaves State Department
changes.summary: Paolo Zampolli, a longtime Trump associate, gained attention earlier this year with a report that his ex-wife had been detained by ICE after his request.

changes.title: 5 Takeaways From the Senate Debate in Maine
changes.summary: The race’s fourth and final debate centered around whether Senator Susan Collins, the Republican incumbent, was as independent as she claimed to be from President Trump.

changes.title: A Bitter White House Feud, Even by Trump-Era Standards: Alina Mildon and Richard Grenell
changes.summary: Two Trump allies — Alina Habba Mildon and Richard Grenell — are locked in a raging dispute that has its roots in the battle for a share of the spoils in Venezuela.

changes.title: Trump’s Deal With Russia Inflames Ukraine War He Vowed to End
changes.summary: The Ukrainian president’s defiant decision to continue attacking Russian refineries underscores President Trump’s inability to end a war he had promised to resolve.

changes.title: Morning news brief
changes.summary: Trump's campaign tour continues as Republicans rally voters ahead of midterms, Ukraine faces limited access to Starshield technology, Houthi rebels hit Saudi oil company building.

changes.title: Ukraine resumes attacks on Russian oil refineries as relations with Trump sour
changes.summary: Ukrainian drones attacked a refinery in Russia's Ryazan region early Thursday, hours after Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said that a brief truce spurned by Moscow was over amid deepening tensions with Washington.

changes.title: Michigan GOP Senate candidate Mike Rogers says he's "not a big fan" of Trump's Russian diesel deal
changes.summary: Vice President JD Vance is campaigning for Republican Michigan Senate candidate Mike Rogers on Thursday night. CBS News senior White House and political correspondent Ed O'Keefe spoke with Rogers ahead of the event.

changes.title: Ukraine resumes strikes on energy targets, saying Russia never stopped its attacks
changes.summary: The tense alliance between Ukrainian President Zelenskyy and President Trump is nearing a new low point. After days of bitter back-and-forth between the two leaders, Ukraine has resumed strikes on Russian energy targets. Trump had demanded an "energy ceasefire" this past Sunday between the two. Russia never stopped its.

changes.title: An accounting of Trump's promised payouts and questions they raise
changes.summary: President Trump is cutting checks to Americans and promising more with less than three weeks left in a midterm cycle largely focused on affordability. Trump argues they're refunds for excessive healthcare costs and promised economic dividends that only his party can deliver. Democrats contend he's trying to bribe citiz.
